result.summary: The page is generally well-structured, but the fixed bottom navigation visibly overlaps the content and some horizontal carousels are clipped at the viewport edge.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation bar covers the lower portion of the second restaurant card, cutting off its image and likely its associated content.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable page content, or ensure the last card can scroll fully above the fixed navigation bar.

issues.description: The category chip row and the fastest-near-you carousel show partially cut-off items at the right edge, which can look like accidental clipping if horizontal scrolling is not obvious.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle scroll affordance, adjust edge padding, or ensure the carousel clipping clearly communicates that more items are available horizontally.
